authorizationText: Autorizo un único redeploy sobre el Hosting DEV de visualización ya existente, vinculando CXOrbia read-only a cxorbia-backend-dev para validar Corte 5 con datos reales; sin crear Hosting ni proyecto Firebase adicional, sin nuevos data writes, Auth/Storage/HR/legacy writes, pagos, merge ni producción.
authorizationCarryForwardReason: The reserved one-shot Hosting authorization remained unconsumed pending secure browser Auth. Corte 6 Auth/RBAC and Firestore Rules are verified PASS. The first Firebase CLI attempt failed because the service account lacks API Keys Viewer permissions required by the CLI; read-only evidence proves Hosting core permissions are present, no new Corte 6 version/release was published, and the remote Corte 6 proof was absent. The same reserved authorization is resumed through the official Firebase Hosting REST API without IAM mutation.

preflight.reason: Read-only root-cause evidence isolates the failure to the Firebase CLI API Keys Viewer dependency. Hosting site/read/update permissions are present and direct Hosting API reads pass. Resume the same reserved one-shot through the official Hosting REST API; no IAM change is required.
